description: This short walk visits Llyn Tryweryn in Gwynedd, North Wales. The small lake is very beautiful with great views across the water to the surrounding mountains of Snowdonia. There is a parking area just west of the lake. You can then follow a pleasant footpath along the northern end of the water.TheCwm Prysor Viaduct Walkstarts near the lake and is a good way to further explore the area.
